# CASPIAN Certificate in Obesity Medicine

> A practical, India-first certificate course that teaches registered physicians (MBBS and above) to treat obesity in the GLP-1 era. Twelve monthly in-person modules in Hyderabad, built around the CASPIAN clinical framework (Classify, Assess, Screen, Personalise, Intervene, Anchor, Nurture), with a course textbook, live assessments, and a verifiable certificate. Offered by Caspian Healthcare Foundation, a registered public charitable trust; directed by Dr Khizer Hussain Junaidy, MD.

Key facts:

- Founding batch begins Sunday, 30 August 2026, capped at 40 seats.
- Format: one 3-hour in-person session a month (Sunday, 10:00 am – 1:00 pm, followed by lunch), for 12 monthly modules plus a convocation.
- Venue: API Hall, Oasis Plaza, Tilak Road, Abids, Hyderabad, India.
- Eligibility: registered modern-medicine physicians, MBBS and above. No prior obesity-medicine training required.
- Founding-batch fee: Rs 2,999 (standard fee Rs 9,999), one-time, paid securely online via Razorpay at https://caspianobesity.com/apply. Includes all sessions, the course textbook ("Obesity Medicine for Indian Practice", 12 modules + 4 clinical appendices), slide decks, assessments and the certificate.
- Money-back guarantee: full refund any time before Session 1; if Session 1 is not value for money, full refund within 7 days of it. After that, one free deferral to the next batch and one free exam retake.
- Assessment: live pre/post quizzes each module, feedback forms, and a 60-question final exam (60% to pass, 75% for distinction). Attendance requirement: at least 80% of live modules (10 of 12); up to two missed sessions can be made up via recording plus that module's assessment within 14 days.
- Certificate: CASPIAN Certificate in Obesity Medicine, issued by Caspian Healthcare Foundation, Hyderabad. Each certificate carries a unique Credential ID and QR code, verifiable at https://caspianobesity.com/verify. It is an independent educational certificate, not a university degree, diploma or fellowship.
- Accreditation status (stated honestly): accreditation by a national professional body in obesity and diabetes is under process; CME credit points will be applied for from the Telangana State Medical Council once accreditation is granted.
- Independence: funded entirely by participants' tuition; no pharmaceutical or commercial sponsorship of content, faculty or assessment.
- Curriculum (12 modules): the new science of obesity; diagnosis, classification & staging (2024 Asian-Indian cut-offs); the obesity consultation; secondary causes & complications; medical nutrition therapy; physical activity, exercise & sleep; behavioural & psychological care; pharmacotherapy I; pharmacotherapy II (GLP-1 and dual GIP/GLP-1 agents and beyond); metabolic & bariatric surgery; special populations; building an obesity practice.
- Course Director: Dr Khizer Hussain Junaidy, MD — diabetologist and obesity specialist, MD (Pharmacology), Fellowship in Diabetes, SCOPE-certified obesity physician (World Obesity Federation), author of the course textbook. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/drkhizerjunaidy/
